title: A swim-off settles the last qualifying place
description: Two swimmers touch in the same hundredth for the last place in the final. The tie is broken by swimming it again — an outcome no measure in this document holds. The ranking declares ties: resolved, so the published positions settle it (spec §8.3.4).

results.notes: Won the swim-off and took the last place in the final.

rankings.label: Semi-finals, swim-off applied
rankings.description: Published positions settle a residual tie; the pair at 58.00 carries none, so that tie stands and is numbered as under standard.

rankings.label: Semi-finals, times alone
rankings.description: The same results without the swim-off: the pair at 56.02 shares second place.
